'''2010 US East Nationals Brian Herold DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Herold]] at [[2010 US East Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)|VB4-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Barnes-y and Friends
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
